metadata.title: OMEGA Global Economic Profile Registry
metadata.dataPolicy: Existing game values are preserved and mapped. Derived values are calculated only from fields present in this repository. Unknown observed values remain null; no missing national statistics are invented.
metadata.provenanceWarning: The existing economy.json baseline has not been independently revalidated against official external statistical sources in this change.

indexMethodology.economicInfluenceIndex: Custom game index from available percentile ranks: GDP 55%, population 20%, foreign-exchange reserves 15%, trade balance/GDP 10%. Missing factors are omitted and the remaining weights normalized. Not an official ranking.
indexMethodology.fiscalRiskIndex: Custom game index: public debt/GDP 40%, inflation 25%, unemployment 20%, budget deficit/GDP 15%. Each factor is capped at 300%, 25%, 35% and 20% respectively. Not a credit rating.
indexMethodology.fiscalHealthIndex: 100 minus the custom fiscal risk index.
indexMethodology.derivedRatios: Debt/GDP, budget balance/GDP, trade balance/GDP, FX reserves/GDP, GDP/person and debt/person are derived from existing baseline fields.
